criteria.text: Patient is at least 12 years old
Prescribed by or in consultation with a specialist in cardiology, lipidology, or endocrinology
Ezetimibe plus atorvastatin or rosuvastatin step
Triple therapy step including a PCSK9 inhibitor indicated for HoFH
LDL-C remains elevated despite PCSK9 inhibitor, statin, and ezetimibe
Female patients: negative pregnancy test and effective contraception counseling during treatment
Baseline LDL-C, total cholesterol, apo B, and non-HDL-C labs documented before treatment
Used in conjunction with a low fat or heart healthy diet

notes: Partial encoding of Alaska Medicaid Evkeeza (evinacumab-dgnb) Criteria Version 1; Original 3/26/2021; Approval 4/16/2021; Effective 5/24/2021.

ANGPTL3 inhibitor indicated as an adjunct to other LDL-C lowering therapies for HoFH in patients aged ≥12 under this source. HeFH and other forms of hypercholesterolemia are excluded by the closed HoFH indication.

HoFH confirmation accepts genetic OR clinical confirmation. Clinical confirmation requires untreated LDL-C >500 mg/dL or treated LDL-C ≥300 mg/dL, together with HoFH manifestations before age 10 or both parents having untreated LDL-C or total cholesterol consistent with HeFH.
Duration (notes only): initial approval up to 3 months; reauthorization up to 6 months with documented current LDL-C reduction from baseline and continued lipid lowering diet and therapy.

Quantity (notes only): 345 mg/2.3 mL vial: 2 vials per 28 days; 1,200 mg/8 mL vial: 1 vial per 28 days; maximum dose 1,890 mg per 28 days. max_units is null; quantity enforcement requires manual review.

Cautions (notes only): monitor for serious hypersensitivity reactions and treat according to standard of care until symptoms resolve. May cause fetal harm based on animal studies; advise contraception during treatment and for at least 5 months following the last dose.

Remains partial: diagnosis, genetic/clinical confirmation, adherent therapy trials, contraindications, LDL thresholds, reproductive counseling, baseline labs and diet are attestations. Evidence verification, duration, reauthorization, quantity and cautions require manual review. PDL status unknown; no alternative packs specified.
